entries.headline: Esmerlyn Valdez connected at +353
entries.story: Esmerlyn Valdez cashed. Facing Robbie Ray, he went deep in the 6th in his 3rd at bat. The call: "Esmerlyn Valdez homers (15) on a fly ball to center field." Final line: 1-for-3 with 1 BB.

entries.headline: Royce Lewis stayed in the yard
entries.story: Royce Lewis went 1-for-5 against Jeffrey Springs and the Athletics. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Byron Buxton came close
entries.story: Byron Buxton went 3-for-5 with 1 BB against Jeffrey Springs and the Athletics. Closest call was a double in the 3rd: "Byron Buxton doubles (18) on a sharp line drive to left fielder Max Muncy." The power showed up; the carry did not.
